title: Worse small appliance I ever purchased.
text: Worse small appliance I ever purchased.. I never thought I would say this about any product I purchased. I would not recommend this toaster to anyone. You have to shove the toast down with you fingers, it has cripping devises in the inside. I have hold down the levers, they flip up on their own. I hate everything about this toaster. I had a normal toaster for 20 years. I visit family and friends and use theirs, they have normal toasters. Whoever designed this toaster had nightmares or is mentally ill. I given mine today to the Salavation Army, after 2 months of grief it is not worth it. Do and I say do not pay it, I am a normal housewife, have never said this about any product. I had this 8 weeks and it is enough, I only use it maybe once a week, that is the reason I have not returned it, I thought it was my bread or me.  Do not waste you money. I am just ordering me another one. I might just try one for 1/2 the price. I am still sick, a good company makes a product like this.

product_metadata.title: Sunbeam 4-Slice Toaster, White (003823-100-000)
features: 4-slice toaster features extra-wide slots to accommodate a variety of items
Centering bread guides allow for even, consistent toasting
7 toast shades from light to dark and a bagel setting
Removable crumb tray makes cleanup easy
High-rise lever for easy toast retrieval
description: Prepare toast that perfectly suits your preferences with the Sunbeam 4-Slice Toaster. This toaster has four extra-wide slots, which means it easily can accommodate bagels, homemade bread, and more. Its bread guides automatically adjust to different bread thicknesses, helping ensure even toasting. Featuring a user-friendly control panel with two dials, the toaster allows you to easily adjust toast shade and cancel toasting with a push of a button. A high-rise lever elevates toast for easy retrieval. This 4-slice toaster also makes cleanup easy thanks to its removable crumb tray, and it helps prevent jams thanks to its anti-jamming mechanism.
